ruleDefinitions.name: Process Monitor Driver Creation By Non-Sysinternals Binary
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of the Process Monitor driver by processes other than Process Monitor (procmon) itself.

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\procmon.*") AND file_path = RGX("\\\.sys$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\procmon\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procmon64\\\.exe$")))
